timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m waiting to hear back and it’s hard.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep checking my phone for a response.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: My mind is replaying the interview over and over.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I’m picking apart everything I said.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels on edge every time it buzzes.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want an answer so I can stop wondering.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me is already preparing for rejection.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this silence is uncomfortable.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This waiting is taking up more space than it should.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let the waiting exist without controlling it.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Checking again will not change the timeline.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I already did what I could in that room.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don’t need to relive every answer.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can loosen its grip on this outcome.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: No news isn’t the same as bad news.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can prepare for either outcome without living in one.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can occupy my mind with something else today.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can set this down for a while.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I did my part, and the rest isn’t mine to carry.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My worth isn’t decided by one interview.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to handle whatever they say.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can focus on my day instead of my inbox.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can rest while I wait.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel hopeful and calm at once.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: There will be other opportunities either way.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can be proud of how I showed up.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to keep living while I wait.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
